notes.title: V1.0.7 Update
notes.notes:
1. Optimize the display of building and upgrading houses
2. Optimize the problem of unclear color display of players and NPCs in the game
3. Fix the problem of jagged avatar display in the game
4. Fix the problem that the latest save file is not at the front in the continue game interface
5. Optimize the display problem of the continue game interface
6. Add the function of automatically selecting the save file in the continue game interface
7. Optimize the personal information interface, remove unnecessary animations, and add a return button
8. Optimize the payment interface, cancel the behavior of forcing players to operate, and change it to pop-up reminders
9. Fix the problem of multiple windows popping up when reaching the target point
10. Optimize the level progress page
11. Fix the problem of multiplayer battle building reading stuck
12. Fix the problem of drawing cards and ending the round directly

notes.title: V1.0.6 Update
notes.notes:
1. Optimized client-side game code
2. Korean language version supported
3. Arabic language version supported
4. configuration updated to support more display resolutions , 
5. Solved the problem of UI dislocation, non-display, deformation and other problems under specific resolutions
6. Supported switching between windows model and full-screen model at each sub-rate 
7. Optimize data reading function 
8. Partial data persistence processing

notes.title: V1.0.5 Upgrade
notes.notes:
1. Optimized the default viewpoint in the game.
2. After the introduction of the mission at the beginning of each game, you need to manually enter the game.
3. Added the content displayed when other players trigger an event or get a card.
4. Improved the effect of characters walking behind buildings.

notes.title: v1.0.3 Update
notes.notes:
1. Added win/lose reason on game result page( player could be bombed even him/her is richer :-) )
2. More languages supported: Polish, Danish, Filipino, Dutch, Latin, Swedish, Greek.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.notes: 1. Add "addtional Content" to unlock the mini-games which used to be in RPG mode

notes.title: version 1.0.1 update
notes.notes:
version 1.0.1 update:
1. Add tutorial functionality to the game
2. Fixed an issue where the in-game volume Settings were reset after switching languages
3. Fixed the video problem of the ending of some characters in the single story mode
